chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
“I have not seen those weak in religion and deficient in intellect more capable of overpowering a person of understanding than you.”

key_terms.أَسْلَبَ: more capable of taking away or overpowering
key_terms.ضَعِيفَاتِ ٱلدِّينِ: those described as weak in religion
key_terms.لِذِي لُبٍّ: for one possessing understanding or sound reason
key_terms.مِنْكُنَّ: than you women / from among you
key_terms.نَاقِصَاتِ ٱلْعُقُولِ: those described as deficient in intellect

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about women being weak in religion and deficient in intellect?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم a statement describing women in terms of weakness in religion and deficiency in intellect, while also emphasizing their strong effect upon a person of understanding. It is presented here as a transmitted prophetic statement within a chapter on blameworthy traits and characteristics of women.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4371 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"I have not seen those who are weak in faith and deficient in intellect more capable of overwhelming a man of reason than you (women)."
